ac3_unit_test_asserts_exact_capital_row_.detail: src/management/pages/RiskCenter.test.tsx includes a dedicated test asserting the exact capital row label text ('Capital (Archived capital pools excluded)' in en-US and '資金 (不含已封存資金池)' in zh-TW, with no digits and no nested parentheses) for a ready pool read while verifying the excluded count (142) remains on risk-matrix-archived-pools-excluded and risk-capital-archived-pools-excluded, and all existing exclusion tests stay green without weakened assertions.
